entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnetup: PowerShell profile may sync across machines #55591
  • FileWatcherTests.NewFile(False) flaky failure — Add and Update events reported out of order #55588

Closed

  • PublishSingleFile publish fails when XML docs are generated but not copied to the output directory #52015
  • Can we finally remove "// See https://aka.ms/new-console-template for more information" from the console template? #36293
  • Projects taking a FrameworkReference to ASP.NET do not get web-project targets settings #36122
    Backlog
  • `dotnet list package` fails when dependency is in TargetFramework matching condition #36033
  • `--sdk-version` option in `dotnet workload install` command is not working in dotnet 8 rc2, but it was working in rc1 and before #36018
  • dotnet new install should not pull down pre-release packages by default #34911
  • Emit a warning when `IncludeAllContentForSelfExtract` is enabled #55535
  • `dotnet test -bl` still writes multiple MSBuild builds into one binlog on device (MAUI) paths #55561
  • `dotnet test -bl` binlog output could be more useful #55187
    Discussion
  • [NETSDKE2E]With NET 10.0.200 preview SDK installed, Some files are not identical in .exe installer and in .zip package. #52506
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-systemconsole: drift detected (#0) #55571
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-iconsole: drift detected (#0) #55570
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-testprogressstate: drift detected (#0) #55569
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-testnoderesultsstate: drift detected (#0) #55568
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-terminaltestreporteroptions: drift detected (#0) #55567
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-ansiterminal: drift detected (#0) #55566
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-reporter: drift detected (#0) #55565
  • NETSDKE2E][Regression] With .NET 11.0.100-preview.7.26379.122 installed by exe installer, failed to update the advertising manifest microsoft.net.workloads: Could not find a part of the path %appdata%\Local\Temp\2igunvgq.qkc\msi\dotnet\sdk-manifests when installing workloads #55548

PullRequests

Created

  • Install preview version of dotnetup by default instead of daily #55600
  • Support solution filter (`.slnf`) inputs in `dotnet workload restore` #55599
  • [WIP] Fix NETSDK1094 during ResolveReadyToRunCompilers #55598
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #55597
  • Change `dotnetup` default `dotnet` install hive (`dotnet` -> `dotnetup/dotnet`) #55596
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55595
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'main' #55594
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.4xx' #55593
  • File-level directives: allow quoting and additional properties #55592
    Area-run-file

Merged

  • Fix PublishSingleFile failure when GenerateDocumentationFile=true and CopyDocumentationFileToOutputDirectory=false #53156
    Area-NetSDK
  • Add --prerelease flag to dotnet new install #55503
  • Add targeted test workflow for agents #55532
  • Document CI telemetry correlation requirements #55556
    documentation, Area-Telemetry
  • Emit NETSDK1244 warning when IncludeAllContentForSelfExtract is enabled #55559
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Set host path for direct MSBuild builds #55581
  • [automated] Merge branch 'main' => 'release/dnup' #55545
  • Extend the single `dotnet test -bl` build session to the device (MAUI) paths #55589
  • Fix corrupted `dotnet test -bl` binary logs by using a single MSBuild build session #55521
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55506
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55191
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55512
  • Migrate GenerateStaticWebAssetEndpointsManifest to IMultiThreadableTask #54706
  • Reconcile testfx terminal allocation drift #55579
  • Fix stale TRX merged-report location in artifact post-processing doc #55577

Updated

  • Fix workload advertising manifest extraction with WiX v4+ built MSIs #55576
  • [Experiment] Create a .NET SDK Issue Monster #55243
  • Enable cached file-based run in Native AOT CLI #55529
    Area-run-file
  • Update the NetAnalyzers Roslyn reference to 4.14.0 #55525
  • Fix `dotnet build file.cs` with MSBuild logger options #54172
    Area-CLI
  • Fix MSBuild telemetry when the server is enabled #55582
    Area-Telemetry, Area-MSBuild
  • Migrate to custom OTel Exporter in `dotnetup` to prevent perf delay and data loss #55421
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55455
  • Add `dotnet test --results-directory-layout` to stop test reports overwriting each other #55475
  • Add affected test selection to dotnet test #55574
  • Onboard the Build Failure Analysis agentic workflow #55539
  • Add pre-MSBuild submission duration metric #55499
  • Remove IdentityModel source-build workaround #55557
    Servicing-consider, Branch Lockdown
  • Update Windows SDK projections #55444
